roundEvolution.title: Round Evolution
roundEvolution.subtitle: Here you can find all legal documentation, privacy information, and account management tools for Round Evolution.
roundEvolution.aboutDescription: Developed by ha516Studio, Round Evolution is a strategic puzzle game where players merge spheres to evolve them into higher forms. Reflecting our commitment to clean design and smooth gameplay, this game challenges your reflexes and planning skills in an engaging arcade experience.
roundEvolution.dataUsageIntro: To provide a seamless experience, improve our services, and offer personalized content, the Round Evolution application may collect limited user data, including:
roundEvolution.dataDevice: Device Information & IP Address: Used for analytics and app performance monitoring.
roundEvolution.dataActivity: App Activity: Used to understand user engagement and improve game features.
roundEvolution.dataAds: Advertising IDs: Used by third-party services (AdMob) to deliver relevant advertisements.
roundEvolution.dataOutro: We value your privacy. All data collection is conducted in accordance with our Privacy Policy and is never sold to third parties.

deletion.title: Account Deletion Instructions
deletion.intro: You can delete your RoundEvolution game account and associated data in the following two ways.
deletion.method1Desc: This is the fastest method, and you can do it directly within the game:
deletion.step2: Tap the Settings button in the bottom right corner of the main screen.
deletion.step4: Tap the red Delete Account button.
deletion.step5: Read the warning message in the confirmation window and confirm the deletion.
deletion.warning: Note: This action will permanently delete all your game progress, purchase history, and account data. This action cannot be undone.
deletion.method2Desc: If you are unable to log in to the application, you can also contact us via email to request a manual deletion:
deletion.emailBody:
Dear RoundEvolution Support,

I would like to request the deletion of my account and all associated data.

User ID: [Your User ID]

I understand that this action is permanent and cannot be undone.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
deletion.outro: We will assist you with the account deletion process within 7 business days of receiving your request.

deletion.title: 帳號刪除說明
deletion.intro: 您可以使用以下兩種方式刪除您的 RoundEvolution 遊戲帳號與相關資料。
deletion.method1Title: 方式一：於應用程式內刪除（推薦）
deletion.method1Desc: 這是最快速的方式，您可以直接在遊戲中自行操作：
deletion.step1: 開啟 RoundEvolution 應用程式。
deletion.step2: 點擊主畫面右下角的 Settings（設定）按鈕。
deletion.step4: 點擊紅色的 Delete Account（刪除帳號）按鈕。
deletion.step5: 閱讀確認視窗的警示訊息，並確認刪除。
deletion.warning: 注意：此操作將永久刪除您的所有遊戲進度、購買紀錄與帳號資料，且無法復原。
deletion.method2Title: 方式二：透過電子郵件申請人工刪除
deletion.method2Desc: 若您無法登入應用程式，也可以透過電子郵件聯繫我們進行人工刪除：

I would like to request the deletion of my account and all associated data.

Sincerely,
[您的名字]

deletion.title: 账号删除说明
deletion.intro: 您可以使用以下两种方式删除您的 RoundEvolution 游戏账号与相关数据。
deletion.method1Title: 方式一：于应用程序内删除（推荐）
deletion.method1Desc: 这是最快速的方式，您可以直接在游戏中自行操作：
deletion.step1: 打开 RoundEvolution 应用程序。
deletion.step2: 点击主屏幕右下角的 Settings（设置）按钮。
deletion.step4: 点击红色的 Delete Account（删除账号）按钮。
deletion.step5: 阅读确认窗口的警告信息，并确认删除。
deletion.warning: 注意：此操作将永久删除您的所有游戏进度、购买记录与账号数据，且无法恢复。
deletion.method2Title: 方式二：通过电子邮件申请人工删除
deletion.method2Desc: 若您无法登录应用程序，也可以通过电子邮件联系我们进行人工删除：
deletion.emailBody:
Dear RoundEvolution Support,

I would like to request the deletion of my account and all associated data.

User ID: [您的用户 ID]

I understand that this action is permanent and cannot be undone.

Sincerely,
[您的姓名]
deletion.outro: 我们会在收到请求后的 7 个工作日内协助您完成账号删除作业。
